sources.title: Logarithmic Sobolev inequalities in discrete product spaces: a proof by a transportation cost distance
sources.exact_use: D(nu||pi) <= 4/[b(1-||A||_2)^2] times the sum of average squared conditional total variation distances.
sources.conditions: Positive conditional floor b, full support here, influence matrix spectral norm below one. It is not a generic row-sum-only Dobrushin result.
sources.published_title: Logarithmic Sobolev inequalities in discrete product spaces
sources.status: Primary full proof inspected; theorem used directly. The corollary with ambiguous printed notation is not used.

sources.title: Logarithmic Sobolev Inequalities for Finite Markov Chains
sources.exact_use: Classical finite-chain normalization and comparison: Ent(f^2)<=C E(f,f) gives hypercontractive exponent 4t/C; use of smoothing with a spectral gap for maximal relative error.
sources.status: Primary source inspected. The required hypercontractive and relative-density derivation is included independently in our proof.

alternative_not_invoked.source: Caputo, Menz and Tetali, Approximate tensorization of entropy at high temperature, 2015
alternative_not_invoked.reason: Its explicit weak-interaction conditions are not the ordinary TV row Dobrushin certificate. Marton's spectral condition is already certified by the ring degree and existing row margin.
